register.formality: "vous" (formal), as the Jira and Azure DevOps French UIs address the reader. Buttons are infinitives (Enregistrer, Supprimer).
register.quotes: « … » with a narrow no-break space (U+202F) inside
register.note: A narrow no-break space (U+202F) before ; ! ? and a no-break space before :. A sentence-final ellipsis is "…". Sentence case for titles.
